plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked minisatellite VNTR/STR barcode & random-match probability chart from Jeffreys, Wilson & Thein (7 March 1985, Nature 314: 67–73) shows polymorphic tandem repeat lengths inherited 50% from each parent and reducing random match probability across multiple loci to <1 in 10^9–10^12 (excluding identical twins), paired with the 1986 exoneration of Richard Buckland.

teach_overlay.label: 10 SEP 1984 DNA FINGERPRINT BARCODE (<1 IN 10^9 MATCH ODDS) & 1986 FIRST INNOCENT EXONERATION
teach_overlay.detail: Inked minisatellite VNTR/STR barcode & random-match probability chart on period paper from Jeffreys, Wilson & Thein (7 March 1985, Nature 314: 67–73) showing polymorphic tandem repeat lengths inherited 50% from each parent and reducing random match probability across multiple loci to <1 in 10^9–10^12 (excluding identical twins), paired with PCR amplification from a single pg of DNA
teach_overlay.scale: although ninety-nine point nine per cent of your DNA is identical to the person sitting next to you, counting the stutters at just a dozen repeating spots makes your genetic barcode rarer than one in a billion
